summary: Phase 5 (Independent Logistics Partner + Driver Workspace, ADR-012) FRONTEND end-to-end test — ALL acceptance criteria PASS. Verified: (1) Partner admin desktop 1440px login demo.logistics@florasetu.dev → /partner/logistics — dashboard shows exactly the 7 buckets with correct counts (New 6, Pickup today 4, Awaiting 1, In transit 0, Delivery today 0, POD missing 0, Exceptions 1) — all bucket testids present (partner-dashboard, partner-dash-new/-pickup-today/-awaiting/-transit/-delivery-today/-pod/-exceptions plus their -card variants). Clicking partner-dash-new-card navigates to /partner/logistics/jobs?f=new with filtered list. (2) Jobs list: all filter chips partner-filter-* + mode select partner-filter-mode + manager toggle partner-jobs-toggle present; cards show HUMAN mode labels ('Reefer road', 'Bus parcel', 'Air cargo', 'Rail parcel', 'Local pickup', 'Insulated road', 'Road' etc — never REEFER_ROAD/BUS_PARCEL raw enums), driver name shown or 'Driver not assigned', next-action text. (3) Road driver job 060585b5: pickup/delivery/transport cards render, temp='Required — maintain cold chain', handling text, driver=Demo Driver, vehicle=KA-04-E-1234, timeline has job-event-driver_assigned. (4) Assign-driver flow on road-no-driver job 47127686: dropdown lists exactly Demo Driver, Demo Driver Two, Demo Logistics Admin (org members); assign → toast 'Driver assigned', driver-name updates, button label becomes 'Reassign driver'; reassign to Demo Driver Two succeeds; unassign returns to 'Driver not assigned' — all with timeline events job-event-driver_assigned/-reassigned/-unassigned. (5) Full manager execution on same job: accept → arrived-pickup → pickup panel (AWB + tref filled) → confirm pickup → transit → arrived-delivery → POD form (deliver-btn correctly disabled without qty, enabled with qty=38) → signature photo input present for road mode → submit → toast 'Delivery recorded — proof of delivery saved', job-pod-card renders with receiver/qty/POD ref/notes/time, ALL action buttons cleared, timeline shows full 8-event chain in order. (6) Bus job bd0cc681: job-carrier-panel with 'KPN Travels' operator + booking ref + terminals + ETD/ETA, job-no-driver-note present, NO assign panel, NO driver field. Rail 5b3940f9 + Air a09d6530 (AWB shown) behave same. Local pickup 4644cf08 correctly renders as road-mode with assign panel + accept btn. (7) Exception job a3d67886: job-exceptions-list shows 'Vehicle breakdown · open · Insulated van breakdown on NH-44 — recovery arranged'; report-issue panel has all 9 human exception types (Pickup delay, Vehicle breakdown, Missed departure, Parcel refused, Damage observed, Temperature concern, Delivery issue, Recipient unavailable, Other). (8) POD delivered job 230df5c1: status Delivered, full job-pod-card with receiver 'Front Desk', qty 40, POD-1789576929, notes 'Received in good order', photo/signature links, timeline has all 8 events, NO accept/pickup/transit/deliver action buttons. (9) Driver mobile 390px: demo.driver@florasetu.dev → partner-home-driver renders with 'Today's jobs', shows ONLY driver-home-job-060585b5 card; opening job shows NO assign panel, NO partner-jobs-toggle; bottom-nav testids present; overlap check — accept btn at y=400 vs bottom-nav at y=791 → NO overlap. demo.driver2@florasetu.dev → home shows 'No jobs assigned to you' (partner-home-driver-empty) since delivered job is not 'today'; Delivered tab correctly shows SHP-2026-000009 Special express Delivered card. (10) Terminology scan on 10 partner surfaces (home, jobs list × 4 filters, 5 job details): ZERO occurrences of QC/INSPECTION/REEFER_ROAD/BUS_PARCEL/RAIL_PARCEL/AIR_CARGO/NORMAL_ROAD/INSULATED_ROAD/LOCAL_PICKUP/SPECIAL_EXPRESS/IN_TRANSIT/procurement/ADR-. Only 'a58e29e4-...' UUID appears which is the preview subdomain, not job data. (11) Regression smoke PASS: public / renders (marketing homepage), demo.buyer → /buyer/home renders, demo.supplier → /supplier/home renders. NO bugs found — Phase 5 is release-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: Console shows repeated wss:// 429 rate-limit errors for Vite HMR websocket through the preview proxy — cosmetic only (dev-server HMR reconnect noise), does not affect user flows. Consider disabling HMR ws in preview builds or setting server.hmr.clientPort correctly to reduce console noise.
test_credentials: As provided in review_request; all 5 accounts (partner admin, driver1, driver2, buyer, supplier) authenticate cleanly against the current seed (tag 1789576929).

Note: the road-no-driver job 47127686 was mutated by the full-execution test flow (now Delivered with POD) — main agent should re-run /app/scripts/seed-phase5-logistics.sh if wanting a fresh planned road-no-driver job for demo, though the road-driver 060585b5 job was left untouched by driver1's mobile test (accept btn was NOT clicked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 fully green. If re-running: (a) seed via /app/scripts/seed-phase5-logistics.sh for fresh IDs, (b) job 47127686 used up by execution flow — pick another PLANNED road job or re-seed, (c) native <select> options for job-assign-select populate async after mount — always wait ~2s after selector visible before querying options.
